name: Links Hoard
purpose: Read-later bookmark library with extracted article text, tags and highlights, stored locally; downloads the video, audio or photos behind a link (YouTube, X, Instagram, TikTok…) to disk, signs in to sites from the app, and leaves a layered text digest of a video (speech, frames, on-screen text, what it sounds like) that an assistant can read, search and question; listens to audio locally (what a sound is, music and effects by section, loudness, recorded or synthesized) with its Sentidos engine.
notes: Own Hoard again (decision of 2026-10-28; it had been folded into Writer's Hoard). Keep the app running (npm start, or start it from Hoard Hub) while the assistant uses it: the MCP bridge proxies every call to the local server and never opens the database itself. save_link waits briefly for the background fetch to report a real title and excerpt. Writer calls this app as an external module to keep references. The audio_* tools need Sentidos prepared once (audio_status with action setup, or the Sentidos page): its own Python environment and about 1.1 GB of models, downloaded on first use.
